summary: Knight civ that takes the map early. The standard French opener is one knight into Pro Scouts and a second stable, about 8 knights by minute 9 and Castle around 12.
openings: Pro Scouts with wheelbarrow: Feudal around 2:30, one knight, then Pro Scouts and an early second stable. They take their own deer first, then yours.
Against slow starters (2 TC, Byzantines) they open with more scouts and no knight to steal deer.

spikes.label: Knight count
spikes.detail: About 8 knights by minute 9 with 11 to 12 archers behind them.
spikes.answer: Spearmen and horsemen against knight-archer; spear-rushing their gold also works.

spikes.label: Castle around 12
spikes.detail: Guild Hall in Castle around 12, a keep for 810 stone, then Imperial with the Red Palace on the big gold.
spikes.answer: Hold your deer and gold early so they can't snowball the map.

scout: Mill plus stable means Pro Scouts and deer stealing
Extra scouts at your deer early means they're starving your food

pairings.why: Knights with 11 to 12 archers is the standard army.

winConditions.detail: Map control with knights from Feudal on.
Guild Hall and Red Palace in the late game.

howToBeat: Use spear and horsemen against knight-archer.
Knights Templar players use the Antioch spear-horse build.
